text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! We can't play it? Why not?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I pass by the arcade one day, I hear
someone
despairing loudly from in front
of one of the
dance game machines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why not? The reason is clearly written. 
"Operation of this game has been
suspended due to a lack of players.
Replacement by a newer machine
scheduled soon."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! But I wanted to show you how cool
I look
when I play!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whyever would you want to do that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, there's nothing we can do
about this.
Why don't we play a
different game?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm gonna go talk to the
manager!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right. I worked things out so I'm
allowed to
play this game as long as I
can find a way to
boost its popularity!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll need you to handle the live stream,
McQueen!
I'm sure everyone will want in
on the fun once
they see me dancing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-wait just a moment! How were you
able to
"work things out" at all?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well, the manager said they shut
this game down because of a lack of
interest, so if we can
attract people's
attention, then problem solved!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So you essentially forced a deal to suit
your own
selfish desire?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with being a little selfish?
It's better
than doing nothing. Besides,
this is to the
arcade's benefit too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to realize how fun this
game is!
Let's get hyped and really show
off what it's
about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So she's not just doing this for her own
gain...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall assist you. ...So what
exactly do I
need to do for this live
stream?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Are you getting this, McQueen? How do
I look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm recording you, and you're doing
fine... Goodness! We already have 5,000
viewers?! The
comments are pouring in,
too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Hey there, everyone! Today, I'm
showing off my favorite dance game. So
stick around, and
I'll show you some
sweet moves!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hm?! Where did this crowd come from?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for watching me strut my stuff! I
hope
you'll give this game a try for
yourselves!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I wanna play too! Teio looked like
she was
having so much fun!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text: Count me in next!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Looks like my plan was a great
success. ♪

text_block_list.name: Arcade Manager
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, you two! I can't believe
you
really pulled it off!

text_block_list.name: Arcade Manager
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to keep this machine in
operation! Thanks for choosing to play
here even though you
could've played
this game at another arcade!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Does that mean we could simply
have
gone elsewhere?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then it wasn't at all necessary to
negotiate with
the manager, let alone
stream everything...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course it was necessary! I mean, I
wanted to
play this game, right here,
right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you created such a
commotion on a mere whim... I suppose
there's a good reason
they call you the
Monarch...
